parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a structural sample-app marker that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The canonical implementation already exists in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel). The copy in DebugHUD.swift is almost certainly inlined to keep the sample app self-contained and avoid a hard dependency on the DebugPanel package. Consolidating would couple production DebugPanel to sample-app semantics or force an undesirable dependency on the example target.
